rationale: The complete original source is retained byte for byte. Quantifying d>=0 with n=d+3 covers exactly every original dimension n>=3 and retains the count5*n-7 without the excluded dimension-two endpoint or a finite cutoff.

The actual determinant differential trace(adjugate(X)*Z) sums adj(X)_ij*Z_ji and remains correct on singular matrices. It does not use an inverse identity invalid on the variety. The source Section3 Lemma2 explicitly confirms that the determinant restricted to X_00=0 is nonzero and squarefree; nonzero multiaffinity excludes repeated factors. The reduced-hypersurface Jacobian criterion therefore identifies exactly the stated restricted nonzero-derivative smooth locus.

The smooth criterion includes membership in both equations and one direction with Z_00=0 and nonzero determinant derivative. It correctly excludes not only rank<=n-2 but also rank-n-1 points whose gradient is entirely normal to the fixed-zero hyperplane. Rank n-1 alone would be insufficient.

At each such smooth point the tangent space is exactly Z_00=0 and DetDifferential(X,Z)=0. Criticality tests every such tangent direction with sum_(i,j)(X_ij-U_ij)*Z_ij=0. The omitted factor2 is nonzero over Complex. Indices are correctly aligned and no conjugation, real restriction, Hermitian norm or Frobenius absolute square is introduced.

One MvPolynomial in all n^2 complex data coordinates with a nonvanishing data witness defines a genuine nonempty principal Zariski open. This is equivalent to a generic locus outside a proper algebraic exceptional set and does not restrict to a normal form, diagonal data or sampled points. The polynomial and witness precede all U in its locus.

A bijection between the complete subtype of smooth critical points and Fin(5*n-7) simultaneously asserts finiteness and exact distinct-point cardinality. It neither totalizes infinite cardinality nor adds multiplicity weights, ordering, nonisotropy or a selected resultant branch. No critical points are omitted by an auxiliary parametrization.
